title: 第十三章 我有一个朋友……
slug: 这个文字冒险游戏绝对有毒
content_zh:
听着门外小雅的声音，沐游在脸上一抹，将打更人的皮肤取消。
照了下镜子，确认样貌和衣物已经恢复成原本的状态后，沐游走去
“老板，仓鼠都被预定完了，我们要不要再去……呃！”
“老板你多久没睡觉了，黑眼圈好重啊！”小雅脸色古怪的看着沐游。
“唔？有吗？”
沐游摸了摸脸，心说怪了，皮肤应该已经换回来了啊……难道刚卸下皮肤之后，黑眼圈这种痕迹还会残留？
“是啊！”
小雅重重点头：“老板你果然是压力太大了吧？不用担心，你看咱们的店铺已经好起来了，肯定不会倒闭的！”
“呃……”
沐游有些哭笑不得，转移话题道：“你刚才说什么？鼠子都卖完了。”
一说起这个，小雅小脸上跳动着一股兴奋：“是啊，所有的仓鼠，都被预定出去了！此外还有龙猫四只，兔子七只，金丝雀三只，鲤鱼六条……”小雅扎着手指头挨个清点。
“这么多？”
这个速度让沐游也很吃惊。
急忙跟着小雅下楼去看了一下。
果然，仓鼠区的笼子已经空了一大半，而剩余的笼子上，也都被顾客贴上了标识着姓名和电话的标签。
这些训练后的宠物受欢迎的程度，简直超乎想象！
“老板，接下来怎么办？我们要不要再去宠物保育基地订购一批宠物？”小雅问。
“这个……暂时先不要。”
沐游想了想还是摇头。
虽说他训练宠物，只需要挥一下魔杖，前后不过十分钟的事，但他却并不想表现的太神异，每天训练个两三只就差不多了，再多的话很容易被人看出异常。

而如今一下预定出这么多宠物，已经足够他训练好一段时间。
况且，店铺火爆的速度过快，也需要一段时间的口碑发酵。
“哦，那好吧。”
小雅也就随口一问，看沐游无意也就没再提了，说完又忙着跑去宠物用品区，招呼起了客人。
现在店里就小雅一个员工，平时人流量少还看不出什么，今天人一多，人手不足的弊病就暴露了出来，她一个人要做平时三四个人的工作。
“是不是该再招点人手呢……”
看着小雅忙忙碌碌的身影，沐游摸着下巴想着。
“如果你们需要订购宠物的话，可以去这家保育基地看看。”这时旁边一个声音响起。
扭头一看，居然是之前那个美女兽医赵倩，此时站在一旁，朝他递出一张名片。
沐游接过名片一看：时代萌宠养殖基地负责人赵xx。
“时代萌宠？你认识这家基地的负责人？”
沐游有些惊讶的看向赵倩。
时代萌宠可是全国有名的宠物饲育基地，出产的宠物质量相当高，价格还便宜，在宠物圈子里可谓有口皆碑。但时代萌宠对于供货方向筛选很严格，很多大宠物店想去进货都没有门路。
沐游也曾经多次向时代萌宠申请过进货渠道，可惜都被拒绝了。
没想到，此时赵倩居然随手拿出了时代萌宠负责人的名片。
话说，这负责人也姓赵，难不成……
“这基地是我家的产业。”
果然，赵倩的说法印证了沐游的猜测。
“原来如此……”
“其实我很好奇，你这里的宠物，究竟是怎么训练出来的？”看对方接下名片，赵倩这才问了出来。

她在这店里逗留了一上午，亲眼见识到了展示区的那些宠物有多神奇。她毫不怀疑，这些宠物就算直接拉去国际宠物大赛上，也都是能得奖的水平。
如果这些宠物出现在一个知名训宠大师手里，她不会奇怪，但偏偏是在这么一个小宠物店里，而且数量还不少……
“抱歉，这个是商业机密，无可奉告。”沐游立即说。
他自己是没有考过训宠证书的，但他父母有啊，他父母可都是正儿八经的专业训宠师，前些年训练过的宠物也不在少数。
沐游一开始就想好了，今后只要有人问他训宠的手段，他就全往父母身上推。
果然，赵倩闻言也没好意思再继续追问，人家已经摆明了这是商业机密，她再问下去就是不识抬举了。
在这里逗留了一上午，赵倩此时也准备离开。
不过在临走之前，她忽然又转头看向沐游，上下打量了他一眼，才问道：“其实我还是无法理解，难道这世界上，真的有天生与动物亲和的人吗？”
虽然沐游没有告诉她训宠的方法，但她多少还是能感觉到，能把宠物训练到这种程度，和训宠手段已经没有太大关系，更关键应该还是‘天赋’。
可她是动物医学专业毕业的高材生，一直以来的教材都在告诉她，在动物眼中，人和人之间没有本质的区别，只有后天行为和气味上的差异，不存在天生亲近某种动物的个体。而今天发生的一切，却似乎悖离了她的这种固有认知。
“这世上不存在无法解释的事，现在无法解释，只是因为我们了解的东西还不够多。”沐游笑着说道。
他想到了自己学会的几个魔法，在不懂魔法的人看来，魔法一定是一种很神奇的东西，根本无法用科学解释。
但在切实使用过魔法之后，沐游却觉得，魔法是一个非常庞杂且严禁的体系，它有着自己完整的逻辑链和内在定理，只是因为这种体系和人类现有的科学体系相悖，所以才导致人类无法理解。
他相信在未来的某一天，随着越来越多的人踏入那个世界，学会越来越多的魔法，神奇如魔法，也终究有被人类彻底解明的一天。
赵倩闻言一阵失神，盯着沐游的脸看了好一会儿，才诧异道：“你跟我一个朋友好像啊……”
“朋友？”
“是的，她也和我说过这句话……而且你们连说话的语气都一模一样！”赵倩感慨着。
沐游眼睛一亮：“你那朋友是做什么的？也是兽医？”
赵倩立即明白了他的意思，翻了个白眼道：“这个你就别打主意了，我那朋友可是动物医学博士学位的高材生，四年前就出国了……”
赵倩没往下说，但意思已经很明白，让这种等级的人才，来一家名不见经传的宠物店工作，合适吗？
content_en:
Listening to Xiaoya's voice outside the door, Mu You wiped his face and removed the waker's skin.
After looking in the mirror and confirming that his appearance and clothes had returned to their original state, Mu You walked over
"Boss, all the hamsters have been booked. Should we go again... uh!"
"Boss, how long have you not slept? The dark circles under your eyes are so heavy!" Xiaoya looked at Mu You with a strange expression.
"Hmm? Is there any?"
Mu You touched his face and thought it was weird, the skin should have been replaced... Could it be that after taking off the skin, traces of dark circles would still remain?
"Yes!"
Xiaoya nodded heavily: "Boss, you are really under too much pressure, aren't you? Don't worry, you see our store is getting better and it will definitely not go bankrupt!"
"Uh..."
Mu You didn't know whether to laugh or cry, so he changed the subject and said, "What did you just say? The rats are all sold out."
When she mentioned this, excitement pulsed on Xiaoya's face: "Yes, all the hamsters have been booked! In addition, there are four chinchillas, seven rabbits, three canaries, and six carps..." Xiaoya pricked her fingers and counted them one by one.
"So many?"
Mu You was also surprised by this speed.
He hurriedly followed Xiaoya downstairs to take a look.
Sure enough, most of the cages in the hamster area were empty, and the remaining cages were all labeled with names and phone numbers by customers.
The popularity of these trained pets is beyond imagination!
"Boss, what should we do next? Should we go to the pet care base to order a batch of pets?" Xiaoya asked.
"This...don't want it for now."
Mu You thought for a while but shook his head.
Although he only needs to wave his magic wand to train pets, which only takes ten minutes, he doesn't want to appear too magical. Training two or three pets every day is enough. If he trains more, it will be easy for others to notice the abnormality.
But now, booking so many pets at once is enough for him to train for a long time.
Moreover, the store is so popular that it will take a while for word-of-mouth to ferment.
"Oh, okay then."
Xiaoya asked casually, and seeing that Mu You had no intention of mentioning it, she stopped mentioning it. After speaking, she hurriedly ran to the pet supplies area and greeted the guests.
Xiaoya is the only employee in the store now. Normally there is not much traffic, but when there are more people today, the shortage of manpower is exposed. She has to do the work of three or four people alone.
"Should we recruit more people..."
Looking at Xiaoya's busy figure, Mu You rubbed his chin and thought.
"If you need to order a pet, you can go to this conservation base." At this time, a voice sounded next to him.
Turning around, he saw that it was Zhao Qian, the beautiful veterinarian from before, standing aside and handing him a business card.
Mu You took the business card and took a look: Zhao xx, the person in charge of the Times Cute Pet Breeding Base.
"Cute pet of the times? Do you know the person in charge of this base?"
Mu You looked at Zhao Qian in surprise.
Times Meng Pets is a well-known pet breeding base in the country. The pets it produces are of high quality and relatively cheap. It is well-known in the pet circle. However, Times Meng Pets is very strict about the direction of supply, and many large pet stores have no way to purchase products.
Muyou has also applied for purchase channels from Times Meng Pets many times, but unfortunately they were all rejected.
Unexpectedly, at this time, Zhao Qian casually took out the business card of the person in charge of Times Cute Pets.
By the way, the person in charge is also named Zhao, could it be possible...
"This base is my family's property."
Sure enough, Zhao Qian's statement confirmed Mu You's guess.
"That's it..."
"Actually, I'm curious, how are the pets here trained?" Zhao Qian asked after seeing the other party take the business card.
She stayed in the store all morning and saw with her own eyes how magical the pets in the display area were. She has no doubt that even if these pets are straightHe has been able to win prizes in international pet competitions.
She wouldn't be surprised if these pets appeared in the hands of a well-known pet training master, but they happened to be in such a small pet shop, and there were quite a lot of them...
"Sorry, this is a business secret, no comment." Mu You said immediately.
He himself has not passed the pet training certificate, but his parents have. Both his parents are serious professional pet trainers, and they have trained many pets in the past few years.
Mu You had already thought about it from the beginning. From now on, whenever someone asked him how to train pets, he would blame his parents.
Sure enough, Zhao Qian was embarrassed to continue asking after hearing this. It was already clear that this was a business secret, so it would be disrespectful for her to ask further.
After staying here all morning, Zhao Qian was ready to leave at this time.
But before leaving, she suddenly turned to look at Mu You, looked him up and down, and then asked: "Actually, I still can't understand. Are there really people in this world who are naturally close to animals?"
Although Mu You didn't tell her how to train a pet, she could still feel that being able to train a pet to this extent had nothing to do with the training method. The more important thing was 'talent'.
But she is a top student who graduated from the veterinary medicine major. The teaching materials have always told her that in the eyes of animals, there is no essential difference between humans, only differences in acquired behavior and smell. There is no individual who is born close to a certain animal. But everything that happened today seemed to go against her inherent understanding.
"There is nothing unexplainable in this world. We can't explain it now just because we don't know enough." Mu You said with a smile.
He thought of some of the magic he had learned. In the eyes of people who don't understand magic, magic must be a very magical thing that cannot be explained by science at all.
But after actually using magic, Mu You felt that magic is a very complex and strictly forbidden system. It has its own complete logical chain and internal theorems. It is only because this system is contrary to the existing scientific system of mankind that it is incomprehensible to humans.
He believes that one day in the future, as more and more people step into that world and learn more and more magic, magic, like magic, will eventually be completely understood by humans.
Zhao Qian was stunned for a while after hearing this, and stared at Mu You's face for a long time before saying in surprise: "You look like a friend of mine..."
"Friends?"
"Yes, she also said this to me...and you even speak in exactly the same tone!" Zhao Qian sighed with emotion.
Mu You's eyes lit up: "What does your friend do? Is he also a veterinarian?"
Zhao Qian immediately understood what he meant, rolled her eyes and said, "Don't make any decisions about this. My friend is a top student with a doctorate in animal medicine. He went abroad four years ago..."
Zhao Qian didn't say anything further, but the meaning was already clear. Is it appropriate for a talent of this level to work in a little-known pet store?
